title: Night Game Drives: Where They Are Allowed
excerpt: Night drives reveal animals you rarely see by day. Where in Tanzania night game drives are allowed.
body:
In most Tanzanian national parks, vehicles must leave before dark. Night drives are therefore only possible in specific areas.

## Where

- Private concessions and wildlife management areas bordering parks, such as around Tarangire and the Serengeti.
- Some areas in the south.
- [West Kilimanjaro](/blog/west-kilimanjaro-safari/).

Rules change, so ask us what is currently possible.

## What you see

Bushbabies, genets, civets, porcupines, aardvarks (with luck), owls and hunting lions.

## How it works

A spotlight is used carefully, often with a red filter to disturb animals less.

See [animals of the night](/blog/nocturnal-animals/) or [plan your safari](/travel-proposal/).
